notes: Beta 1.1.1.5-beta2: decouple directory change detection from individual metadata probe failures so unreadable audio files no longer trigger whole-library rescans on every launch; failed metadata entries are tracked in a bounded retry queue with backoff while preserving valid tags and directory fingerprints. · 测试版 1.1.1.5-beta2：解耦目录完整性与单文件元数据探测，不可读音频不再导致每次启动整库重扫；失败项保留有效标签并进入退避重试队列，目录指纹正常落地。
